name: gencreator-native
description: Portable production, launch and multi-brand operations workflows with local execution.

interface.longDescription: Three local workflows: source-to-edition production, launch packets and creator operations. Includes evidence and revision checks, editable drafts, multi-brand job planning, supplied subscription audits and inventory-aware stack decisions with prepared workflow bindings. Optional remote MCP uses the existing GenCreator public endpoint; verify its tool list. Managed workspace access requires OAuth/readiness. This plugin does not start agents or publish.
defaultPrompt: Use GenCreator to turn this transcript into a reviewed content week.
Build a source-backed launch packet for this offer.
